results.name: A delayed submit cannot duplicate a decision or claim it is saved; distinct decisions queue without interrupting browsing
Reload discovers unknown in-flight work and blocks duplicate filing until the durable result is available
A stale captured filing stamp rejects the queued decision, clears Saving, and remains available for explicit retry
Queued cancellation remains pending and a completed filing retains real Undo
A committed decision stays guarded during a failed snapshot read and confirms only after recovery

scope: Actual local host, PowerShell adapter and generated PDFs. A bounded gate is inserted only in the copied fixture before durable preflight, with a separate delayed POST. Checks queued distinct filing, duplicate prevention, truthful saving state, browsing, true reload with the first job-list response held, stale failure, cancellation, Undo, snapshot-read failure/recovery and protected source/clinical/cache bytes. Includes 1024×768 and 683×384 effective-viewport geometry with actual filing progress and a forced synthetic connection notice; this is not actual Windows DPI testing. Does not measure hospital workstation speed or establish Windows execution when run on Linux.
